solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Hapless comic, floundering, concludes successfully

indicators.note: something floundering struggles about in disorder, so the letters before it lose their order

parts.note: the twelve letters of these two words, used as fodder

explanation.surface: An unlucky comedian struggling on stage still manages to bring the act to a triumphant close.
explanation.definitionFit: To accomplish something is to carry it through to completion, a direct synonym of concluding successfully.

clue.text: Pavlova maybe following strip finding neckerchief

indicators.note: following means coming after, so the dancer's name is placed second, behind the word for a strip

parts.note: a band is a narrow strip of material
Anna Pavlova was the famous Russian ballerina; 'maybe' marks her first name as one example

explanation.surface: A meringue dessert is served after a striptease, oddly turning up a scarf.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pavlova' tempts as the meringue pudding, but it is the ballerina, and 'following' puts her name after the strip.
explanation.definitionFit: A bandanna is a large coloured kerchief worn knotted around the neck or head.

clue.text: Is able to accommodate large family

indicators.note: to accommodate is to give room inside, so one piece is housed within the other

parts.note: 'can' means is able
L is the clothing-size abbreviation for large

explanation.surface: Someone has enough room at home to put up a big family.
explanation.definitionFit: A clan is an extended group of related families, especially in Scotland, so it is a family in the broad sense.

clue.text: Trouble experienced lifting flower

indicators.note: in a down clue lifting lets the letters rise, so they read from the bottom upward

parts.note: to ail is to trouble or afflict
had an experience of, as in 'had a fright'

explanation.surface: Someone who had a bad back found it hard bending to pick a flower.
explanation.definitionFit: The dahlia is a garden plant grown for its showy, many-petalled blooms, so it is one example of a flower.

clue.text: Film bloke, genuine and spiritual

parts.note: E.T. is Spielberg's film about an extraterrestrial
a bloke is a man, he
real means genuine

explanation.surface: A man in a movie comes across as sincere and otherworldly.
explanation.definitionFit: Ethereal means heavenly or unworldly, delicate beyond the material, which matches spiritual.

clue.text: Pay for infantry

definitions.meaning: first meaning: to settle a cost

explanation.surface: Someone must cover the wages of the foot soldiers.
explanation.definitionFit: The word is a verb for meeting a bill and an old collective noun for soldiers who fight on foot rather than horseback.

clue.text: Slow progress made by our monarch altering law

indicators.note: altering something changes its form, so the letters of the word after it are rearranged

parts.note: CR is Carolus Rex, King Charles, the current British monarch
the three letters to be rearranged

explanation.surface: Reform of the law under the King is moving at a snail's pace.
explanation.definitionFit: A crawl is a very slow rate of movement, as in traffic moving at a crawl.

clue.text: New tram for painting or sculpture say

indicators.note: something new has been made afresh, so the letters following it are put in a fresh order

parts.note: the seven letters to be rearranged

explanation.surface: A new tram is commissioned as a public piece of painting or sculpture.
explanation.definitionFit: Painting and sculpture are examples of an art form, a recognised medium of artistic expression; 'say' flags them as examples.

clue.text: Car company in December's relocated: eastern New Zealand

indicators.note: relocated things have been moved to new spots, so these letters are set down in another order

parts.note: the letters of DECEMBERS rearranged
E is the abbreviation for eastern
NZ is the abbreviation for New Zealand

explanation.surface: A carmaker's December operations move to the east of New Zealand.
explanation.walkthrough: The apostrophe in December's is ignored, so all nine letters are rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: Mercedes-Benz is the German manufacturer of luxury cars, part of the Mercedes-Benz Group.

clue.text: For example, first or second row to get spoken about

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so one word goes around the other

parts.note: oral means spoken rather than written
a row, rhyming with cow, is a noisy quarrel, a din

explanation.surface: A list of who comes first or second gets argued over.
explanation.walkthrough: Row here is the noise, not a line of seats; 'spoken about' places the spoken word outside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Ordinal numbers show position in a sequence, and first and second are examples.

clue.text: Log found in frozen terrain

indicators.note: found in says the letters sit inside the words that follow, running across them

parts.note: the letters run from the end of the first word into the second

explanation.surface: A tree trunk lies preserved in icy ground.
explanation.walkthrough: Log looks like a piece of wood but is the verb, to record.
explanation.definitionFit: To enter data is to record it, the same as logging it in a book or system.

clue.text: Copper computer network initially enhanced for a song

parts.note: a copper is a low-value coin such as a penny
LAN is a local area network

indicators.note: initially points at the opening letter of the word it is attached to

parts.note: the first letter of enhanced

explanation.surface: A police officer's computer system was first upgraded to play music.
explanation.walkthrough: Copper suggests a policeman but is the coin.
explanation.definitionFit: Penny Lane is the Beatles' 1967 single about a street in Liverpool.

clue.text: Old European turning up in Kyiv, also Guyana

indicators.note: in a down clue turning up flips the letters so they read from the bottom upward
in says the letters lie inside the words that follow, spanning them

parts.note: the letters running across these words, read backwards

explanation.surface: A former Balkan citizen shows up in Ukraine's capital and in South America.
explanation.definitionFit: Yugoslavia broke up in the 1990s, so a Yugoslav is a citizen of a European country that no longer exists.

clue.text: Every so often I'd buyer needing to be paid

indicators.note: every so often means at regular intervals, so only every other letter is kept

parts.note: the second, fourth and sixth letters

explanation.surface: A shopper is told that occasionally payment is required.
explanation.definitionFit: A bill that is due is owed now, so it needs to be paid.

clue.text: Motivation and method required to find parking place?

parts.note: drive is energy and determination
a way is a method of doing something

explanation.surface: Getting somewhere to leave the car needs determination and a plan.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark admits the definition is a description: a driveway is where many people park.
explanation.definitionFit: A driveway is the private road outside a house where the occupant usually leaves the car.

clue.text: Princess in opera is doing aria, first of all

indicators.note: first of all asks for the leading letter of each of the words before it

parts.note: the opening letters of these three words

explanation.surface: A soprano playing a princess sings her big solo before anything else.
explanation.definitionFit: Princess Ida is the title character of the Gilbert and Sullivan comic opera of 1884.

clue.text: Girl realigned reforms

indicators.note: reforms means forms again, so the letters before it take on a new shape

parts.note: the nine letters to be rearranged

explanation.surface: A young woman who was realigned changes her ways.
explanation.definitionFit: Geraldine is a female first name, and crosswords often define a name simply as girl.

clue.text: Tool used to cut letters on grave spotted

parts.note: RIP, rest in peace, is carved on headstones
saw means spotted, noticed

explanation.surface: A stonemason's chisel carves an inscription on a tombstone, then gets spotted.
explanation.definitionFit: A ripsaw is a coarse-toothed hand saw for cutting wood along the grain.

clue.text: Half-hearted welcomes for signs of saintliness?

indicators.note: half-hearted says half of the centre is missing, so one of the middle pair of letters goes

parts.note: hallos are greetings

explanation.surface: Lukewarm greetings for people who think they are holy.
explanation.walkthrough: The heart of the six-letter greeting is its double L; losing one of them halves it.
explanation.definitionFit: A halo is the ring of light drawn around a saint's head, so it signals saintliness.

clue.text: Left, united, repeated something outstanding

parts.note: L is the abbreviation for left
U is the abbreviation for united, as in football club names
the same pair of letters given a second time

explanation.surface: A political rallying cry of left and unity, chanted twice, makes a stir.
explanation.definitionFit: A lulu is informal slang for a remarkable or exceptional person or thing.

clue.text: One who demonstrates British saying

parts.note: a prover is one who proves or demonstrates
B is the abbreviation for British

explanation.surface: A protester demonstrating in Britain chants a slogan.
explanation.definitionFit: A proverb is a short traditional saying stating a general truth.

clue.text: Gem, old, found by New York Times

parts.note: O is the abbreviation for old
NY is the abbreviation for New York
x is the multiplication sign, read as times

explanation.surface: An antique jewel is discovered by the New York Times.
explanation.walkthrough: The New York Times newspaper must be split: New York and Times are separate pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: Onyx is a banded variety of chalcedony used as a semi-precious stone in jewellery.

clue.text: Sovereign's wife backed US lieutenant with articles

indicators.note: backed means moved backwards, so the word after it is read from right to left

parts.note: taken as written, then turned around
Lt is the abbreviation for lieutenant
an and a are indefinite articles

explanation.surface: A queen consort supported an American army officer with documents.
explanation.definitionFit: A sultana is the wife of a sultan, the sovereign ruler of a Muslim state.

clue.text: Long twelve months ending in confusion

parts.note: a year is twelve months

indicators.note: an ending is the last letter, so only the final letter of the next word is used

parts.note: the final letter of confusion

explanation.surface: A long year finishes in chaos.
explanation.walkthrough: Long looks like an adjective but is the verb, to long for something.
explanation.definitionFit: To yearn is to long for something intensely, an exact verb synonym.
